thought.text: A stale pid file conflict (same tmp/pids path as dev server). Let me start production with its own pid file:

reasoning_content: Stale pid file issue: the dev server is running on port 3000 with the same pid file, so the production server won't start. I'll stop the production server process and retry with a different pid file, or use `-P` to specify a separate pid file.

action.command: cd /workspace && export PATH=/usr/local/ruby/bin:/opt/node/bin:$PATH PGPASSWORD=root && (nohup env RAILS_ENV=production bin/rails s -b 0.0.0.0 -p 3001 -P tmp/pids/prod_verify.pid > /tmp/prod_verify.log 2>&1 & echo "started") && sleep 60 && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" http://localhost:3001/ && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /users/sign_in: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" http://localhost:3001/users/sign_in

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && export PATH=/usr/local/ruby/bin:/opt/node/bin:$PATH PGPASSWORD=root && (nohup env RAILS_ENV=production bin/rails s -b 0.0.0.0 -p 3001 -P tmp/pids/prod_verify.pid > /tmp/prod_verify.log 2>&1 & echo \"started\") && sleep 60 && curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"GET /: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\\n\" http://localhost:3001/ && curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"GET /users/sign_in: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\\n\" http://localhost:3001/users/sign_in", "summary": "Start production server with separate pid file"}
